newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee ends down after hitting 1996 low.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee ends down after hitting 1996 low.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee cut losses after touching a fresh 1996 low against the dollar, which rose on speculation, but still ended lower than Thursday's close dealers said.

The rupee closed at 56.08 after opening at 55.93, both down from Thursday's close of 55.87. Earlier, the rupee slumped to a 1996 low of 56.20 on speculation the Central Bank wanted to see the local currency fall further, dealers said.
"But the rupee rowed back when a state bank began selling aggressively," said a dealer.
